description: Generated from an empty temporary profile using production initializers. The explorer inspects the actual running profile instead.

databases.sourceOfTruth: Definition files own the index; approvals, runs and local bindings exist only in this database.
Notes and documents under each project's memory folder. The database is a rebuildable index.
Authoritative conversation state. Do not delete or rebuild from an index.
Authoritative custom skill library. Bundled skills are supplied separately.
Authoritative interface state after the one-time JSON import.

objects.name: artifacts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE artifacts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL,content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: automation_state
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE automation_state(
        automation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        next_due_at INTEGER,approved_hash TEXT,approved_at INTEGER,
        inputs_changed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,error TEXT)

objects.name: automations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE automations(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: definition_errors
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE definition_errors(project_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_path TEXT NOT NULL,error TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: effect_cancellations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE effect_cancellations(
        delivery_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES effect_outbox(id), requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: effect_dismissals
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE effect_dismissals(
            effect_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES effect_intents(id),
            intent_hash TEXT NOT NULL, dismissed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: effect_intents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE effect_intents(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        artifact TEXT NOT NULL, intent_key TEXT NOT NULL, intent TEXT NOT NULL,
        intent_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id,intent_key))

objects.name: effect_limits
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE effect_limits(
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL,
        revision TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(project_id,kind,target))

objects.name: effect_outbox
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE effect_outbox(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, effect_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES effect_intents(id),
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL,
        intent_hash TEXT NOT NULL, limit_revision TEXT NOT NULL, handler_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','in_flight','uncertain','delivered','cancelled')),
        queued_at INTEGER NOT NULL, not_before INTEGER NOT NULL,
        reserved_at INTEGER, receipt TEXT)

objects.name: plugin_state
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_state(plugin_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,approved_hash TEXT,approved_at INTEGER, approved_inputs TEXT CHECK(approved_inputs IS NULL OR json_valid(approved_inputs)))

objects.name: plugins
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE plugins(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: project_conversations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE project_conversations(pane_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: project_proposals
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_proposals(
            message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,command_hash TEXT NOT NULL,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('applying','saved','declined')),
            output_hash TEXT,entity_id TEXT, accepted_command TEXT CHECK(accepted_command IS NULL OR json_valid(accepted_command)))

objects.name: project_skills
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_skills(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: projects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE projects(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: repository_paths
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE repository_paths(project_id TEXT NOT NULL,repository_id TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project_id,repository_id))

objects.name: resource_types
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE resource_types(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: resources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE resources(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: run_events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE run_events(run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(run_id,sequence))

objects.name: runs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,automation_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,occurrence_at INTEGER,retry_of TEXT REFERENCES runs(id),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','waiting_input','cancelled','interrupted','skipped')),snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot)),input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,started_at INTEGER,finished_at INTEGER,stop_requested_at INTEGER,result TEXT,error TEXT)

indexes.name: project_runs
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX project_runs ON runs(project_id,requested_at DESC,id)

objects.name: tools
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE tools(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,plugin_id TEXT,
            source_path TEXT NOT NULL,source_hash TEXT,valid INTEGER NOT NULL,error TEXT,
            body TEXT CHECK(body IS NULL OR json_valid(body)),
            UNIQUE(project_id,source_path))

objects.name: errors
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE errors(project TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,path))

objects.name: links
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE links(project TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,target TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: notes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE notes(project TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL,
              tags TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL,created TEXT NOT NULL,supersedes TEXT,expires TEXT,
              stamp TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,id)) WITHOUT ROWID

indexes.name: notes_recent
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX notes_recent ON notes(project,created DESC)

objects.name: notes_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE notes_fts USING fts5(title,tags,body,project UNINDEXED,id UNINDEXED,tokenize='porter unicode61')

objects.name: notes_fts_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: notes_fts_content
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4)

objects.name: notes_fts_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: notes_fts_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: notes_fts_idx
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: documents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
                         pane TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)),
                         PRIMARY KEY(pane, kind))

objects.name: retired_epochs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE retired_epochs (
                         pane TEXT NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(pane, epoch))

objects.name: transcript_messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE transcript_messages (
                         pane TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)),
                         PRIMARY KEY(pane, position))

objects.name: transcripts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE transcripts (
                         pane TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: migrations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE migrations(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

objects.name: skills
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE skills(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body)))

objects.name: entries
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE entries (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(value)))
